scope: Editorial screening of current Auction Geek records against auctioneer particulars, with recalculated yields. Legal packs and rent receipts have not been reviewed. Recheck availability, guide, rent, addenda and publishing permission immediately before scheduling.

posts.angle: Recognisable tenant, accessible guide and strong advertised yield
posts.qualification: Freehold shop and upper parts let to British Heart Foundation. Savills states a lease expiry of 9 June 2029 and that the property is elected for VAT. The yield is gross at guide, not a guaranteed return or evidence of tenant credit strength.
posts.caption:
A freehold shop let to British Heart Foundation, with a £180,000 guide.

61 Northgate, Darlington produces an advertised £27,500 annual rent: a 15.28% gross yield at guide, before purchase and running costs. The lease expires in June 2029, and Savills notes that the property is elected for VAT.

Savills auction: 3 November 2026.

Would the rental return and recognisable tenant put this on your shortlist?

posts.angle: London commercial property at a £250,000 guide
posts.qualification: Retail and lower-ground office space let at £30,000 annually. Approximately 93 years remain on the ownership lease; the occupational lease began in June 2025 for 12 years. The advertised six-month rolling break belongs to the landlord. Residential conversion is not an approved or guaranteed outcome.
posts.caption:
London commercial property with a £250,000 guide and £30,000 advertised annual rent.

207 Belsize Road, NW6 comprises a ground-floor shop and lower-ground offices. That is a 12% gross yield at guide, before purchase and running costs. The ownership is leasehold, with approximately 93 years remaining.

Auction House London: 11 November 2026.

Would you favour a London location over a higher headline yield elsewhere?

posts.angle: A small freehold workshop and yard at an unusually accessible price
posts.qualification: Detached workshop with ancillary first-floor space and a yard. Advertised rent is £4,200 annually, under a lease expiring in August 2028. The £1,800 administration charge alone takes the cost at guide to £30,800; rent divided by that amount is 13.64%, before all other costs. This is a small property, not a large industrial unit.
posts.caption:
A freehold workshop and yard with a £29,000 guide.

Rear of 292 Weelsby Street, Grimsby is advertised at £4,200 annual rent: a 14.48% gross yield at guide, before costs. The lease expires in August 2028. The auctioneer’s £1,800 administration charge is additional.

Auction House London: 12 November 2026.
